- PO 45012 is correct and should be referenced verbatim on the final invoice.
- We will accept reverse-charge, please use the reverse-charge variant and add our EU VAT/TIN on the invoice header (VAT TIN: EU123456789).

- We prefer the invoice split into two clear line items: "Subscription true-up" and "Applied credits" so our AP system maps amounts correctly.
- Payment method: wire transfer to the account you provide (SEPA preferred if possible; otherwise USD wire is fine).

If you can update the reverse-charge invoice with our VAT TIN and attach your W-9, we will route payment approval today and expect payment within Aurora standard net-30 after invoice acceptance.

Thanks — attaching a signed copy of the PO for completeness.
